en: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph of a historical hospital ward. Several soldiers, some in uniform and others in bed, are attended by nurses dressed in traditional long white habits, possibly nuns. The setting features curtained hospital beds, ornate woodwork, and a high ceiling with paintings. The overall atmosphere is orderly and solemn, typical of early 20th-century wartime hospitals.
